user.title: Set up When to Ventilate
user.description: Create the integration now, optionally with a default reference climate.

default_reference.title: Choose the reference area
default_reference.description: A reference is an area whose air is compared with your rooms, typically a balcony or outside area.

room_sensors.title: Room sensors
room_sensors.description: Select the temperature and humidity sensors for {area_name}.

error.area_not_found: The selected area no longer exists.
error.invalid_temperature_sensor: Select a sensor with the temperature device class.
error.invalid_humidity_sensor: Select a sensor with the humidity device class.

user.title: Choose a room
user.description: Select the Home Assistant area to configure.

details.title: Room climate
details.description: Configure the sensors and reference for {area_name}. Without custom hysteresis values, the global values apply: relative humidity {global_relative_humidity_on}/{global_relative_humidity_off} %, absolute difference {global_absolute_humidity_on}/{global_absolute_humidity_off} g/m³.

reconfigure.title: Configure room
reconfigure.description: Update the sensors and reference for {area_name}. Without custom hysteresis values, the global values apply: relative humidity {global_relative_humidity_on}/{global_relative_humidity_off} %, absolute difference {global_absolute_humidity_on}/{global_absolute_humidity_off} g/m³.

error.area_not_found: The selected area no longer exists.
error.invalid_temperature_sensor: Select a sensor with the temperature device class.
error.invalid_humidity_sensor: Select a sensor with the humidity device class.
error.reference_not_found: The selected reference no longer exists.
error.invalid_hysteresis: The turn-off value must be below the turn-on value.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The room configuration was updated successfully.

init.title: Configure When to Ventilate
init.description: Configured references: {reference_count}. Add and configure rooms from the integration page.

configure_hysteresis.title: Configure ventilation thresholds
configure_hysteresis.description: These global values apply to every room without custom hysteresis values. The minimum temperature always remains room-specific.

manage_reference.title: Add or edit a reference
manage_reference.description: Choose an area. Choosing an existing reference edits it.

remove_reference.title: Remove a reference
remove_reference.description: References currently used by a room cannot be removed.

configure_room.title: Add or edit a room
configure_room.description: Choose a Home Assistant area. Choosing a configured area edits it.

room_details.title: Room climate
room_details.description: Configure the four required values for {area_name}. Without custom hysteresis values, the global values apply: relative humidity {global_relative_humidity_on}/{global_relative_humidity_off} %, absolute difference {global_absolute_humidity_on}/{global_absolute_humidity_off} g/m³.

data_description.minimum_temperature: A new recommendation starts 0.5 K above this value and may remain active down to this value.

room_hysteresis.title: Custom hysteresis values for {area_name}
room_hysteresis.description: Set the individual humidity thresholds for this room. The cooling-protection hysteresis remains global.

disable_room.title: Disable a room
disable_room.description: This removes the room's sensor assignment. It does not change or delete the Home Assistant area.

hysteresis.title: Custom hysteresis values for {area_name}
hysteresis.description: Set the individual humidity thresholds for this room. The cooling-protection hysteresis remains global.

error.reference_in_use: This reference is still used by at least one room. Change or disable those rooms first.
